content.title: Oscars 2026 live stream: Check date, time and where to watch the Academy Awards in US, UK, Canada
content.text: Oscars 2026 date, time and where to watch The 98th Academy Awards will celebrate the best films of 2025 at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles on Sunday, March 15, 2026. Organized by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, the ceremony honors outstanding achievements across 24 competitive categories. The event is expected to attract millions of viewers worldwide as Hollywood gathers to recognize the year’s most acclaimed films, performances, and technical achievements.Also Read: Oscars 2026 Red carpetHow to watch Oscars 2026 in CanadaIn Canada, viewers can watch the Oscars airing at 7 pm ET on CTV and ABC. A livestream of the Oscars is available in Canada on the CTV app and CTV.ca. Bell's streamer Crave will also carry the Oscars live, but you need a subscription.Also Read: Oscars 2026 Winner List Live UpdatesHow to watch Oscars 2026 in the USIn the United States, the ceremony will air live on ABC. Viewers can also stream the event online through Hulu and other live-TV services that carry ABC affiliates.How to watch Oscars 2026 in the UKIn the United Kingdom, the Oscars will be broadcast on ITV. The ceremony will also be available for streaming on ITVX for viewers who prefer to watch online.How to watch Oscars 2026 in AustraliaAustralian audiences can watch the ceremony on Seven Network and stream it through 7plus. Because of the time difference, the broadcast typically airs Monday morning in Australia.Who is hosting Oscars 2026The 2026 ceremony will be hosted by Conan O'Brien. Known for his long career in late-night television and comedy, O’Brien has hosted shows such as Late Night with Conan O’Brien and Conan. His sharp humor and improvisational style are expected to bring energy and entertainment to the Oscars stage.How does 2026 Oscars voting work?The Oscars are administered by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, which includes thousands of members from across the film industry. Members nominate candidates within their professional branches, such as actors nominating actors or directors nominating directors, while the entire membership votes to determine the final winners in most categories.Who are the 2026 Oscars presenters?The ceremony traditionally features a lineup of celebrity presenters including actors, filmmakers, and previous Academy Award winners. The full list of presenters is usually announced shortly before the ceremony.What channel is Oscars on 2026In the United States, the Oscars will air live on ABC. In the United Kingdom, viewers can watch on ITV and stream through ITVX, while audiences in Australia can tune in via the Seven Network and 7plus. Canadian viewers can access the ceremony through television providers that carry the ABC broadcast feed.Who are the 2026 Oscars Best Actor nominees?Timothée Chalamet - Marty SupremeLeonardo DiCaprio - One Battle After AnotherEthan Hawke - Blue MoonMichael B Jordan - SinnersWagner Moura - The Secret AgentWho are the 2026 Oscars Best Actress nominees?Jessie Buckley - HamnetRose Byrne - If I Had Legs I'd Kick YouKate Hudson - Song Sung BlueRenate Reinsve - Sentimental ValueEmma Stone - BugoniaWho are the 2026 Oscars Best Supporting Actress nominees?Elle Fanning - Sentimental ValueInga Ibsdotter Lilleaas - Sentimental ValueAmy Madigan - WeaponsWunmi Mosaku - SinnersTeyana Taylor - One Battle After AnotherWho are the 2026 Oscars Best Writing (Adapted Screenplay) nominees?Bugonia - Will TracyFrankenstein - Guillermo del ToroHamnet - Chloé Zhao and Maggie O'FarrellOne Battle After Another - Paul Thomas AndersonTrain Dreams - Clint Bentley and Greg KwedarWho are the 2026 Oscars Best Director nominees?Paul Thomas Anderson - One Battle After AnotherRyan Coogler - SinnersJosh Safdie - Marty SupremeJoachim Trier - Sentimental ValueChloé Zhao - Hamnet
